line: An inventor's blueprint draws, explodes and assembles a cloud-catching machine, and its revision cloud starts to rain.
line_cn: 发明家的蓝图自己画出一台接云机器，修订云线变成了真的雨云。

camera.expresses: scale, the document as an object
camera.serves: establishing; a verdict; a series of sheets

camera.move: Medium on a figure, subject ~80 % of height, sky on one side
Track along a path of force (chain, pipe, wire, beam)
camera.serves: how it works; a sequence of operations
gears meshing; a valve; a joint

camera.expresses: the flat drawing "turns" and gains thickness
camera.serves: from plan to object; a reveal of depth

camera.move: Lateral pan across Fig. 1 → Fig. 2 → Fig. 3

transitions: Transitions: cuts on downbeats, or fig-number rewrites on the sheet;
labels: Hand lettering for header, labels, notes and subtitles (e.g. Architects Daughter); a technical sans for title-block fields (e.g. B612); a script only for the signature (e.g. Allura). All OFL.
Text is written on left to right with a glowing nib, like everything else.

Subtitles are drawing notes: a light translucent box with double white rules, a "NOTE / n" cell, the text lettered on in ~0.35 s, a small leader tick. Placed per shot in empty sky, never fixed to the bottom (the bottom of a drawing is ground line, base and title block). Wrap at ~880 px. Hold ≥ max(1.8 s, speech + 0.6 s).
Every subtitle is also lettered into the sheet's GENERAL NOTES column, so the final wide shows the whole voiceover as drawing notes.
motion: Camera and draw-on on ones (24 fps). Continuous moves within a section, hard cuts on downbeats between sections; tiny camera bumps only for physical impacts (paper slap, stamp).
Draw-on truncated by arc length with a glowing nib at the head; items staggered within a layer; each layer starts on a beat.
Drafting order: centre lines → outlines → detail → hatching → dimensions → balloons → labels.
Exploded views: parts leave in sequence on subdivisions of the beat, eased, and return one per beat-group with a click.

native_moves.name: Drafting order
native_moves.does: The object draws itself as an engineer would, a layer per beat.
native_moves.fits: a bridge; a violin; a kitchen renovation.

native_moves.name: Live annotations
native_moves.does: Dimensions measure moving parts and the numbers change; balloons fly with parts; a section line reveals the inside.
native_moves.fits: a heart valve; a folding bicycle; a rocket stage separating.

native_moves.name: Fig. numbers as transitions
native_moves.does: "FIG. 1" struck through and rewritten "FIG. 2 · EXPLODED VIEW".
native_moves.fits: versions of a product; phases of a construction; a recipe's stages.

native_moves.name: Projection as camera
native_moves.does: The oblique factor animates; exploded parts fly along the depth axis.
native_moves.fits: a floor plan becoming a building; a circuit board; flat-pack furniture.

native_moves.name: A symbol made real
native_moves.does: (once, if at all). A convention leaves the drawing language: a dimension arrow flies, a hatch becomes rain, a centre line becomes a road, a weld symbol sparks.
native_moves.fits: an invention finally working; a city plan becoming a street; a dream becoming a plan.

native_moves.name: Cyanotype and water
native_moves.fits: a flood-defence design; grief; a harbour wall.

native_moves.name: The title block as story
native_moves.does: Status field = the verdict; revision rows = history.
native_moves.fits: a rejected permit; REV. 1–5 of a city; an approval after years.

score.note: contrapuntal, mechanical: harpsichord, bassoon, spiccato, imitative lines
